Event

Aloha! Bubble Island

Enjoy yourselves with your friends, and build this place into a popular resort!

Activity TypeGveResortIslandPhases4Duration7 or 8 days

Across all phases

Core Rewards

GameplayEvent Rules7 sections
Basic Rules

◆ Bubble Island is a guild-based event.

◆ On Bubble Island, Transcenders spend dice to roam the region and trigger various kinds of events.

◆ The object is to collect event points and achieve as high a ranking as possible. Complete more laps to claim super achievement rewards.

Bubble Island Event Types

◆ Transcenders will receive event points when they reach any square.

◆ Guild Registry: Obtain a random card.

◆ Spot of Trouble: There is a chance to encounter monsters, guild members can be invited to attack the monster together.

◆ Bubble Inn, Dolphin Dock, Forest Adventure, Bubble Rafting: "Like" these buildings as you pass by. After accumulating enough likes, all guild members will receive rewards.

◆ Beach Paradise: "Like" this building as you pass by. After accumulating enough likes, the ATK of all guild members on Bubble Island will increase.

◆ Flower Boost: Obtain a random elf and gain a buff.

◆ Treasure Shells: Draw a card from several shells.

◆ Treasure Hunter: Transcenders can trade with the little treasure hunter boy to obtain rare items.

◆ Souvenir Shop: Transcenders can purchase discounted rare items.

◆ Lady Octopus: Transcenders will be trapped by Lady Octopus when they reach this square. There are three ways to escape: wait for 10 minutes, escape manually, or ask guildmates to rescue you. After a successfully rescue, the Transcender and their guildmate will both receive chests.

◆ Bubble Transport: Get a random Swimming Ring Car buff, which increases movement distance while traveling on Bubble Island.

◆ Hidden Path: Activate a hidden path with many rare rewards inside. Activating a hidden path allows players to share a Hidden Path Chest.

◆ King of the Forest: Encounter a Strong Gorilla, there's also a chance to meet the Beautiful Gorilla. The Beautiful Gorilla can be attacked by all guild members, who will receive rewards after defeating it.

Using Items

◆ Selectable Dice: Control the number of spaces you move. Can be used to enter a Hidden Path or encounter the King of the Forest.

◆ Guild Blessing Card: Increase the event points when guild members reach any square by 1% for each card. This item is most effective when more guild members are online.

◆ Battle Enhancement Card: Increase your ATK by 100 on Bubble Island. This item is most effective when facing strong opponents such as Strong Gorilla and Beautiful Gorilla.

Personal Points Bonus

◆ When Transcenders reach a certain amount of points, they will receive a bonus to event points.

Upgrading the Guild Plaza

◆ After the points of all guild members reach a certain threshold, they can begin to upgrade the appearance of the Guild Plaza. All guild members can claim the corresponding upgrade rewards.

Leaderboards and Rewards

◆ Event points determine individual rankings and guild rankings. Transcenders can receive ranking rewards based on their rankings.

◆ Unclaimed rewards will be sent to players in the mail after the event has finished.

◆ As the event is held multiple times, the variety of rewards will become increasingly rich, and an exchange shop will be opened for redeeming rare rewards.

◆ Note: Members who leave the guild during the rewarding period will not receive any guild rewards!

◆ After leaving the guild during the event, personal points remain unchanged. The guild points of the original guild will have the departing member’s personal points deducted. Upon joining a new guild, personal points will be added to the new guild's points.

MVP

◆ The Transcender with the highest points in the guild with the highest points during the event becomes the MVP.

◆ If the MVP leaves the guild, the Transcender with highest points in the current guild becomes the new MVP.
